extra.message: The 'count' parameter is not bounded. An attacker can supply a very large integer to cause excessive memory allocation and CPU consumption when building the 'rows' list.

extra.message: The Origin header is reflected into Access-Control-Allow-Origin and Access-Control-Allow-Credentials is set to true. This allows arbitrary origins to make authenticated cross-origin requests.
